# Style index

<!-- generated by scripts/styles-index.mjs from styles/*/style.json and styles/catalog.json; do not edit by hand -->

67 styles. 53 can be drawn entirely in code; 14 need real material the owner supplies.
This account's styles (`account.json` → `styles`): default **storybook**, allowed: `storybook`.

Before using any style read [`ADAPTING.md`](ADAPTING.md), then `styles/<folder>/STYLE.md`.
Poster sheet to choose from: `bash studio/render-style-picker.sh [style ...]` → `styles/picker/*.jpg` (no names = every style).

**Renderer:** svg = React/SVG kit · canvas = `<StyleCanvas>` 2D · three = `<StyleCanvas>` + three.js.
**Material:** – = all drawn in code · real = needs real footage, photos, scans or data.

| Copperplate Engraving | [`engraving`](engraving/STYLE.md) | canvas | – | An intaglio plate that engraves itself: a burin cuts swelling lines into copper, a proof is pulled, and the figure builds up — outline, hatching, cross-hatching — until engraved lettering, magnified details and a hand-laid wash make a finished plate. |  |
| Halftone Dossier | [`halftone-dossier`](halftone-dossier/STYLE.md) | canvas | – | A retro print case file: cream archive paper, overprinted halftone dots in a few flat inks, huge heavy headlines with misregistered shadows, rubber stamps that slam, and thick-outlined characters. | Good for 'the case of…' and myth-busting reels. |
| Printed Long Take | [`printed-long-take`](printed-long-take/STYLE.md) | three | – | A three-dimensional world rendered as a scratchboard print, ink and paper with one red, crossed by one unbroken camera move. | One unbroken camera move: plan the whole route before drawing. |
| Risograph Print | [`risograph`](risograph/STYLE.md) | canvas | – | Animation that looks printed, frame by frame, on a stencil duplicator: two or three translucent spot inks overprinted on warm paper, halftone dots, ink grain, and plates that never quite line up. |  |
| Silkscreen Travel Poster | [`silkscreen-poster`](silkscreen-poster/STYLE.md) | canvas | – | Opaque, hard-edged flat inks pulled one colour at a time through a screen: 4–6 inks per poster, stepped colour bands instead of gradients, thin paper-white gaps where the registration slips. | Good for covers and carousels too. |
| Woodcut Print | [`woodcut`](woodcut/STYLE.md) | canvas | – | A relief print that carves itself: every frame is a black wood block, and light only exists where a knife has cut it away. |  |

| Data Physicalization | [`data-physical`](data-physical/STYLE.md) | three | – | Real statistics built as real objects: every unit is a countable piece of material (a plate, a block, a coin, a bar) stacked to exact scale on a crafted base, shot like a product in a studio — soft key, long shadows, shallow depth of field, physically based materials. | Real statistics built as objects: every number sourced, as BRAND.md asks anyway. |
| LiDAR Survey | [`lidar-survey`](lidar-survey/STYLE.md) | three | **real** | Real airborne laser points of a real place, floating in the dark as a measured cloud; a scan line or a cutting plane passes through them and the points condense into a solid, raking-lit surface, which is then measured with hairline instruments. | Needs a real laser-scan point cloud. |
| Microscope Story | [`microscope`](microscope/STYLE.md) | canvas | **real** | Real, licence-clean microscopy of a real specimen, seen as it is, and one continuous change of scale that carries the viewer from the glass slide in the hand to a single cell. | Needs real, licence-clean microscopy. |
| Satellite Briefing | [`satellite-briefing`](satellite-briefing/STYLE.md) | canvas | **real** | Real satellite imagery of a real place, graded down to an analyst's grey, with thin white measurement lines drawn on the ground: a lock-on reticle, outlines, a range line, one reading. | Needs real satellite imagery with a licence that allows reuse. |
| Exploded Teardown | [`teardown`](teardown/STYLE.md) | three | **real** | A real product, built from its own engineering files (CAD, PCB layout, bill of materials), lit like a studio packshot and taken apart in front of the camera: the layers lift on one axis, the camera travels between them, every part is named with the numbers its files contain, and it closes again into one object. | Needs the product's real engineering files. |
| Projection on White Model | [`white-model`](white-model/STYLE.md) | three | **real** | A pure white massing model of a real place stands on a plinth in a dark room, and a projector paints data onto it as light: one layer at a time, falling on the surfaces that face it, spilling a little past the plate. | Needs real building and map data for the place. |
